svg.title: F33-2 Quick-reference sheet 2: mechanical and fire acceptance values
svg.text: no leak; no drop after temp. correction
≤ 5 K in 15 min; ≤ 20 K in 1 h
What to prove on the record
1. The pressure test certificate gives the gauge class, the pipe temperature trend and the high-point pressure.
2. The water release certificate attaches the accredited laboratory report against BG 29 Table 4.
3. The CDU and fire records give each event time so the 30 s, 60 s and 50 s limits can be checked.
F33-2 Quick-reference sheet 2: mechanical and fire acceptance values
hydrostatic ≥ 1.5 × design · BG 29 TVC < 10,000 cfu/ml, SRB absent · inlet 18 to 27 °C · CDU stop ≥ 58.0 L/s in 30 s · VEWFD ≤ 60 s · agent hold ≥ 10 min · pre-action ≤ 50 s
• Pipework passes the hydrostatic test at 1.5 times the design pressure at every point with no leak after temperature correction.
• A clean-agent room passes the door fan test when the predicted hold time is 10 minutes or more at the protected height.
